name: The Girl I Met at the End of the World
source:
What do you do when your entire world has been destroyed?
Venture into a strange world of mystery and half-fulfilled prophecies and help a sorrowful girl find some hope for that world.

[From [url=https://pneumavoid.itch.io/the-girl-i-met-at-the-end-of-the-world]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你的整个世界都已毁灭，你会怎么做？
踏入一个充满谜团与未尽应验的预言的陌生世界，帮助一位悲伤的少女，为这个世界找到一丝希望。

[摘自[url=https://pneumavoid.itch.io/the-girl-i-met-at-the-end-of-the-world]Itch.io[/url]]
